hook: Your humming can name a song you forgot.
title: Your Humming Can Name Any Song
description:
The Google app can identify a song from your humming alone. Hum for 10 to 15 seconds and it lists the matching tracks on screen. Try it on the tune stuck in your head.

#Shorts #Tech #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Which song will you hum first? Name it

scenes.narration: Your humming can name a song you forgot.
scenes.headline: HUM, GET THE SONG

scenes.narration: Open the Google app on your phone.
scenes.headline: OPEN GOOGLE APP

scenes.narration: Tap the mic, then tap search a song.
scenes.headline: TAP SEARCH A SONG

scenes.narration: Now hum the tune for ten to fifteen seconds.
scenes.headline: HUM 10-15 SECONDS

scenes.narration: No lyrics, no singing, just the melody.
scenes.headline: JUST THE MELODY

scenes.narration: A list of matching songs appears on screen.
scenes.headline: MATCHES APPEAR

scenes.narration: That tune stuck in your head now has a name.
scenes.headline: SONG FOUND

scenes.narration: So go hum something right now.
scenes.headline: HUM IT NOW
scenes.sub: Tomorrow: the mountain taller than Everest
